scope: 99 newly added tests and 2 revised existing fixtures from implementation; the original 62-case inventory remains separate.

cases.scenario: CRLF input and small paragraphs preserve source order, keep three heading scopes separate, and retain exact byte slices.
Backtick and tilde fences of different lengths, indented code, hashtags, and quoted headings cannot replace the real heading.
Skipped heading levels preserve hierarchy, separated closing hashes are removed, and a title such as C# remains intact.
Merged whitespace and multi-byte Unicode sliding windows preserve exact source slices and ten-character overlaps.
Embedding identity distinguishes endpoint and model while keeping URL credentials out of the persisted identity.
KWIC centering and highlights point to the original accented character after an earlier lowercase expansion.
Lowercase expansions and shrinking characters map back to whole original characters during highlighting.
Unicode keyword matches merge across spaces, remain separate across newlines, and handle overlap and empty input.
At 99, 100, 101, and 1001 collisions, language/owner filters precede pagination and stable pages contain no gaps.
MCP symbol pages over 101 matches expose accurate totals and continuation; an end page is empty success, not false symbol absence.
Text and JSON retrieval reject limits 0 and 1001 as errors while a genuine absent symbol remains NotFound.
A local mock embedding transport retrieves a popular utility plus an isolated match; impact overflow preserves both hits with accurate per-result completeness status.
Package entry and regular module dependency identities remain distinct so removal/restoration invalidates the correct consumers.
Rebinding synthetic persisted symbols preserves recorded local parent and namespace identity instead of selecting another owner.
Old second-valued persisted timestamps require a content hash before treating a file as unchanged.
Coarse or future timestamps do not hide changed source bytes.
Go implementation evidence distinguishes pointer-only Socket/value embedding from pointer embedding, and excludes a wrong parameter signature.
Two promoted same-name methods remain ambiguous; a field blocks promotion, while a direct method resolves it.
Grouped and unnamed parameters normalize to the same signature; embedded interface requirements merge, while arity and variadic/slice differences remain distinct.
Private method names and shadowed builtin type names remain package-specific.
Same-spelled array constants from different packages do not prove equal parameter types; equivalent numeric literal radices do match.
All 128 complete local structs are discoverable as empty-interface implementers without a hidden result cap.
Large UTF-8 byte columns survive storage encoding and reader reload without narrowing.
A malformed qualified code query matches the containing analyzed phrase while rejecting wrong namespaces and nonadjacent token decoys.
The real watcher reconciles a nested policy-only exclusion and reinclusion without a source-file touch.
Watcher preparation tracks a policy file inside an initially excluded directory so a future inclusion can be observed.
A literal route registration keeps the handler as a References edge with an exact source span, without inventing immediate execution.
A passed imported callback alias resolves to its actual provider declaration.
A parameter or destructured parameter shadow prevents a callback reference to the same-named global function.
String arguments and unsupported member expressions do not turn into guessed bare callback targets.
Forcing a previously indexed document replaces its generation and leaves exactly one live chunk for the source.
Forcing collection A preserves collection B file ownership and freshness state.
A source included by two collections is either indexed in the second collection or rejected explicitly; success cannot silently omit it.
A directory plus its explicit child file indexes that source once.
Content changes under an identical historical mtime replace the old document preview.
Changing max chunk size from 256 to 50 rechunks an unchanged 200-character document into four chunks.
Enabling a deterministic mock model after metadata-only indexing backfills the missing vectors.
Switching between distinct mock models with equal vector dimensions rebuilds or fails explicitly; mixed vector spaces cannot silently return the wrong text.
A deterministic first-batch embedding failure can be retried in the same store without falsely accepting a chunk with no vector.
After an embedding failure and store reopen, retry produces one live metadata chunk.
With embeddings disabled, a nonexistent literal query returns no chunks.
A payload beneath Alpha then Beta carries both headings in that order.
A shell comment inside a fenced code block cannot replace the surrounding document heading.
After merging small paragraphs, slicing the original source by the chunk byte range reproduces its content exactly.
A document preview containing dotted capital I before an accented match remains safe under Unicode lowercasing.
Unchanged indexing performs no second mock embedding request, and deleting the file removes its search hits.
A multi-root mutation sequence matches a fresh graph after each transition in both caller/callee root orders.
After persistence and reopen, creating a previously missing import target repairs the unchanged caller and matches a fresh graph.
An import-only Python barrel edit after reopening dynamic roots retargets its unchanged consumer to the correct module.
Changing a left package target does not reparse or change IDs in an unrelated right package with the same relative import spelling.
The file cap applies globally and deterministically across roots, and a zero-file inventory cannot establish a deletion.
A bounded barrel update followed by persistence and reopen repairs resolution without requiring another source edit.
Incremental C3 dispatch retains the exact imported ancestor identities across unchanged files.
Changing an interface signature removes stale structural implementations without rebinding to an unrelated same-name declaration.
Changing an embedded method recomputes implementation evidence for an unchanged wrapper.
A pointer-only Go implementation keeps explicit receiver evidence on its stored relationship.
The full Python graph retains annotation dependencies without inventing eager calls.
A postponed annotation mentioning compute_type produces Uses evidence and no eager Calls in either extraction pass.
Each Python base retains its own ordered source position rather than sharing the containing class range.
Invoking a local indexed variadic callable with zero, one, or multiple arguments cannot become a call to a shadowed generic function named handlers, in either extraction pass.
A self.run call chooses A through first base X before the later direct base Y.
An unresolved explicit Base import blocks a lone global Base decoy for both self and super dispatch.
An inconsistent C3 hierarchy remains unresolved for self, super, and annotated receivers.
